item.title: CBS pulls report challenging Trump foreign policy
item.description: What’s behind the canceling of the 60 Minutes story on El Salvador?

item.title: Inflatables, rainbow crosswalks, flooding snitch lines—creative action was off the charts in 2025
item.description: In the face of rising authoritarianism, creativity is an enduring movement superpower that helped us break through the stranglehold of fear this year.

item.title: Instacart ends use of AI-powered pricing experiment on consumers
item.description: Instacart's Eversight pricing tool allowed retails on its platform to experiment with pricing using AI, which could cost the average household up to $1,200 every year in additional spending.

item.title: Over 20M Americans set to lose healthcare coverage Jan. 1 after Congress goes on recess
item.description: Health insurance premiums are expected to more than double or even triple for some 20 million people, pricing many out of healthcare coverage entirely.
